body:
Minor release **v1.14.0** (1.13.0 → 1.14.0). Per repo convention the minor slot is bumped because `NEWS.md` lists a `💥breaking` change: the optimal-LAI API changes of #1901 (tree/grass leaf costs and area-index coefficients, the required `tree_share` of `ZhouOptimalLAIModel`, and the renamed or re-signed `compute_A0`, `compute_L_max`, `compute_L_steady_target` and `potential_evaporation`).

## Contents
- **`Project.toml`**: `version` 1.13.0 → 1.14.0.
- **`NEWS.md`**: froze the `main` section as `v1.14.0` and opened a fresh empty `main`.
- **Manifests**: `Pkg.update()` of the four tracked Manifests (`.buildkite` and `docs`, Julia 1.10 and 1.12).

## NEWS entries added
Three changes merged since v1.13.0 had no `NEWS.md` entry:
- ✨ GRACE artifact, calibration target, and `twsa` diagnostic (#1930)
- 🚀 mutable model structs, compile time to the first step 307 s → 162 s (#1906)
- 🔥 removal of the unbounded canopy heating of coupled simulations: `CoupledAtmosphere` gustiness, P-model floors, absent-canopy relaxation with the new `absent_canopy_relaxation_time` parameter (#1923)

The two entries of #1932 (ClimaDiagnostics v0.4, diagnostics reproducible on restart) are in the `v1.14.0` section with their PR links.

Also added the missing PR links to the entries of #1926, #1928 and #1918, and corrected "Requires SurfaceFluxes 1.5" to 1.6, the current compat. #1935 (long-run CI only) needs no entry.

## Notable dependency updates
- **ClimaDiagnostics 0.4** (from #1932, already on `main`): v1.14.0 requires it.
- **CUDA 5.11.3 → 6.4.1** and **GPUCompiler 1.17.1 → 2.10.0** in `.buildkite`. ClimaCore 1.0.6, ClimaComms, ClimaTimeSteppers and ClimaUtilities all declare CUDA 6 compat and ClimaLand does not bound CUDA, so users of v1.14.0 resolve to CUDA 6; the GPU jobs of this PR test that. If they fail, the fallback is to hold CUDA at 5.x in `.buildkite` and move to CUDA 6 in a separate PR.
- ClimaCore 1.0.3 → 1.0.6, ClimaParams 1.3.1 → 1.3.4, ClimaAnalysis 0.5.24 → 0.5.25, MPI 0.20.27 → 0.20.29, TimerOutputs 0.5.29 → 1.2.2 (`.buildkite`).
- HDF5_jll, NetCDF_jll and (Julia 1.12) MPICH_jll move down in `.buildkite` to the versions the `docs` Manifests already used.

## After merge
Comment `@JuliaRegistrator register` on the merge commit; TagBot creates the `v1.14.0` tag and GitHub release.

body: With the `climaland-downstream` buildkite pipeline, the concurrency limit can stop ClimaCore land downstream test and vice versa. This is due to the `concurrency_group` being the same for both pipelines. This PR updates `concurrency_group` to `depot/${BUILDKITE_PIPELINE_SLUG}`. For the ClimaLand CI, this is `depot/climaland-ci` and for the land downstream tests, this is `depot/climaland-downstream`.
title: Update concurrency group to use pipeline slug
